ModuleMetaData.DescriptionHeadline: GUCEF asset converter plugin: Unreal package reader
ModuleMetaData.DescriptionDetails: The importer "unreal" reads the structure of Unreal editor packages (.uasset, .umap, and the .mhpkg archives) through the VFS by range: the summary with its version branches for engine releases 4.14 to 5.8, the version context with the custom versions, the name, import and export tables, the soft object path list, the package trailer and the references to payloads. The tagged properties of an export are read in both tag layouts (classic and complete type name) into a data node tree. Skeletal meshes (editor LOD models with up to twelve bone influences per vertex, reference skeleton, material slots, LOD screen sizes) are converted into the intermediate scene with their skeleton, and their materials are resolved along the parent chain of the material instances to the master material and mapped to metal-roughness by a rule table; textures (the source forms PNG, JPEG and raw pixels) become image files and are put in the slots of the materials that name them, and static meshes (the mesh descriptions of the editor packages of UE 5) become meshes of the scene. Payloads compressed with Oodle are decompressed by the external tool ooz_extract, a separate program that is started as a child process (never linked) from the folder of the host application; without the tool nothing fails: the assets that need it say so in their reports and CUnrealCapabilities tells the host. Animation, levels, the delta texture source form of UE 5.6 and later and the UE 4 raw mesh are not yet read.
